notes.title: Highscores!
notes.content:
High score support is added to Bloodworks. Currently it only shows your high score and your percentage in the global list. More will be added in the future.

High scores are only enabled if you have no mods installed or mods are disabled in the options menu. This also means that all old high scores are cleared since it was possible to post high scores while using mods. Sorry if your score was legit!

notes.title: Steam Workshop support has arrived!
notes.content:
I discarded old mod upload system, which was a pain to use, and added Steam Workshop support instead. Now you can download user mods using the workshop.

This also means that all old mods are discarded, sorry to brave people that wrote mods on first day of release.

Feel free to ask me any questions if you are interested in creating user mods!

notes.title: Bloodworks is out!
notes.content:
Bloodworks is an indie title I was working as a hobby project for a while and finally I was able to make it public to everyone!

Please give it a try and report any problems you can find. It is a one-person project, so there are probably still some bugs I couldn't find myself. 

There are a few reviews that reports performance spikes for ultimates and I tried to improve things a little I hope it is a little better now.
